businessModel: Free plan plus credit-based subscriptions at $20, $85 and $250 per month
summary: Stockholm startup's browser that exits beta as v1.0 (Oct 26, 2026): build and share AI "companions" for sales, recruiting and support. macOS and Windows; EU data residency option; model agnostic; $6M backed.
bestFor: European orgs wanting EU data residency
notFor: Individuals wanting a personal daily browser

pros.title: Shared team companions
pros.detail: Trained companions can be shared, scheduled or triggered by new emails/leads.

pros.title: EU data option
pros.detail: Customers can keep data within the EU; passwords stay in the browser (vendor).

pros.title: Human approval
pros.detail: Companions pause before sending emails, publishing posts or changing records.

pros.title: Local meeting capture
pros.detail: Records meetings locally so no bot joins the call.

cons.title: Brand-new 1.0
cons.detail: Left beta Oct 26, 2026; one outlet says features arrived well before the 1.0 date.

cons.title: Credit pricing
cons.detail: Plans scale to $250/mo with credit usage.

cons.title: Details thin
cons.detail: Engine, extensions and models are not stated.

cons.title: Small company
cons.detail: 12 staff; Series A not yet confirmed.

faq.a: Yes there is a free plan; paid credit tiers are $20, $85 and $250 per month.
Stockholm-based, co-led funding from General Catalyst and EQT Ventures ($6M, Oct 2025).

pageLoad: Chromium rendering; AI sidebar adds overhead
networkSpeed: Chromium network stack with HTTP/3 and preloading
startup: Chromium cold start, heavier than plain Chrome
memory: Chromium multi-process plus AI layer; RAM-heavy
cpu: Chromium-class; agent tasks add background load
lowEnd: Needs modern hardware; AI features add load
installSize: Full Chromium bundle, a few hundred MB
privacyDefaults: EU residency and local capture; cloud models
blocking: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite are available
securityHardening: Human approval gates; engine hardening unverified
patchSpeed: Follows Chromium stable; lag not independently measured
behaviourCustom: Few shortcut or per-site options documented
tabManagement: Tab groups and search; no workspaces documented
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus
translation: AI-driven page translation; no dedicated engine
extras: AI agent and memory; no VPN or wallet
accessibility: Chromium accessibility stack, unverified for AI layer
businessTrust: EU startup, named VCs, small team

featureNotes.adBlocker: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite
featureNotes.commandBar: Address bar doubles as AI prompt
featureNotes.mv2Support: MV2 removed upstream; Chrome Web Store dropped MV2 Aug 31, 2026
